name: Cosmic Emergence Agent
description: Autonomous agent that monitors SuperRare auctions, detects visual peaks in a live 4K WebGL animation, and mints Bidder Edition NFTs to each bidder wallet at the moment of maximum visual impact.

decision_loop.discover: Poll Sepolia auction contract via Infura RPC eth_getLogs every 8 seconds
decision_loop.plan: On new bid event: compute bidder hue from wallet address bytes, determine geometry type from bid amount, calculate phase boost
decision_loop.execute: Inject bid pulse into WebGL animation, register PeakWatcher scoring every frame at 24fps
decision_loop.verify: PeakWatcher requires 2 consecutive decay frames after 400ms minimum window before firing
decision_loop.submit: Capture raw RGBA frame, encode PNG server-side, upload to Pinata IPFS, mint ERC-721 to bidder wallet via Rare Protocol CLI

safety_guardrails: 100ms minimum gap between captures prevents duplicate frames
Buffer size validation before PNG encoding (width x height x 4 bytes)
Automatic retry with 500ms delay on failed fetch
MAX_WINDOW 3000ms hard deadline ensures every bid gets a capture
knownBids Set prevents processing the same transaction twice
Mint only after PNG successfully saved to disk
